title: Mutable Contact Ledger: local memory update and unseen composition screen
research_question: Can a small model with locally updated memory preserve comparable answer correctness at lower fully accounted cost as the number of facts grows, when facts are replaced and answers require composition?

task.name: mutable_contact_ledger_v1
task.source: original deterministic procedural generator; no external corpus
task.input_format: Timestamped short natural-language ledger statements followed by one natural-language query.
task.fact_example: At step 014, Neri's amber contact became Luma.
task.replacement_example: At step 031, Neri's amber contact became Sora, replacing the earlier contact.
task.query_example: Starting at Neri, follow amber, then copper, then jade. Which contact is reached now?
task.answer_format: Exactly one canonical entity token or UNKNOWN; deterministic exact-match scoring after normalization of surrounding whitespace only.
task.semantics: Each (entity, relation) key has one current value; the highest timestamp replaces prior values. A query follows the current value for its ordered relation sequence. Missing links yield UNKNOWN.
task.knowledge_size_definition: K is the number of distinct current (entity, relation) keys after all replacements; stale statements remain in the visible history.
task.distractors: Every world contains lexically overlapping off-path keys, stale replaced values and near-match entity/relation statements. Distractors are sampled independently of the answer and are included within K.
task.unseen_composition: For D=2 and D=4, half of final queries use ordered relation tuples absent from train and development while every individual relation and every shorter constituent occurs in training.
leakage_guards: split by whole generated world before serialization
disjoint world seeds and entity inventories across train, development and final
no evidence IDs, graph edges, answer labels or generator state exposed to a system
timestamps and raw statement order are the only update-order information
final seeds are runner-random and unavailable before recipe freeze
all systems receive byte-identical raw text and queries for a cell

data_split.selection: At most two complete development attempts. Select one full frozen recipe using only development macro exact match, then seal all systems and thresholds before final generation.
data_split.final_access: One later registered screen only after separate authority; no final inspection, rescue tuning or replacement seed.

tokenization.method: One shared 2048-entry byte-pair vocabulary learned only from training text, plus byte fallback.
tokenization.sharing: The same frozen tokenization is used by every learned system; the classical control receives the identical UTF-8 text.
tokenization.cost_accounting: Tokenizer learning, serialization and per-event/query tokenization time and peak memory are charged and reported.
tokenization.context_guard: Every serialized full-history example must fit the frozen 8192-token limit; violation before scoring blocks the cohort rather than truncating evidence.

systems.specification: Decoder-only causal transformer, 6 layers, 6 heads, width 384, context 8192, learned positions, pre-layer normalization, GELU MLP, tied embeddings and constrained one-entity answer decoding.
systems.training: AdamW/cosine recipe adapted from the already validated PC-01 control; identical train/dev units and per-role fit cap; no pretrained weights.

systems.specification: BM25 index over raw ledger statements. At each reasoning hop, retrieve top-4 using the question and current predicted entity; at most 16 unique statements reach a source-comparable small transformer reader. Index construction, each lookup and reader work are charged.
systems.training: The reader uses the same tokenizer, width/depth family, train/dev units and fit cap as the dense baseline; retrieval parameters are frozen after development.

systems.specification: A disclosed deterministic parser for the public ledger grammar, a timestamped hash map with last-write-wins replacement and generic pointer traversal for D hops.
systems.privilege_boundary: It receives raw text only, never generator objects, evidence IDs or answers. Its hand-written grammar and update/composition rule are declared task-specific prior structure; runtime, parser failures and state are charged. Code-authoring time is disclosed but excluded for every system.
systems.purpose: Calibrate task validity and test whether a learned system is merely an expensive recreation of explicit retrieval/rules.

systems.specification: A learned text encoder writes key/value vectors into one bounded fast-weight associative matrix. A replacement applies only the delta update M <- M + eta * (v - M k) k^T for the encoded key. A learned controller performs exactly D reads and produces one entity.
systems.fixed_mechanism_under_test: Local delta correction of an existing associative key without global parameter training or append-only storage at update time.
systems.forbidden_shortcuts: No timestamp sort outside the learned memory, no symbolic key table, no raw-statement cache consulted at query time, no generator graph and no per-world gradient update.

systems.specification: Use the candidate's encoder, controller, dimensions, initialization family, tokenizer, training budget and answer head, but store every encoded statement in an append-only list and retrieve top-4 by similarity; no delta overwrite. Retrieved records retain their public timestamps.
systems.isolated_contrast: delta_fast_memory_v1 minus append_only_similarity_memory_v1 isolates local delta overwrite from ordinary learned similarity retrieval while the classical control separately exposes gains available from hand-written parsing/rules.

quality: overall exact-match accuracy by K and D
unseen-composition exact-match accuracy for D=2 and D=4
cost: initial ingestion and retrieval-index construction time
per-replacement update p50 and p95 latency
per-query p50 and p95 latency at batch 1 with device synchronization
peak process RSS, CUDA allocated and CUDA reserved bytes
persistent model, memory and index bytes
estimated operations and bytes touched, explicitly labelled estimates
complete workload cost at reuse counts Q=1, 16 and 256 queries per world

amortization.formula: C_A,Q = tokenizer_fit/A + model_fit/A + corpus_encode + index_or_memory_build + updates + Q*query, reported per query and per world
amortization.shared_costs: Shared generator cost is reported and included in absolute totals; no system may omit required preprocessing because another role already paid for it.

measurement.timing_protocol: Same idle local device, fixed CPU thread count, no concurrent GPU job, 20 warm-ups then at least 100 measured operations per reported latency statistic, explicit CUDA synchronization, raw samples retained.
measurement.uncertainty: World-clustered paired bootstrap with 10000 deterministic resamples and two-sided 95% intervals. Timing intervals resample whole measured worlds. Seed variability is not estimated by the one-seed screen.

control_validity: symbolic_last_write_graph_v1 overall exact match >= 0.995 and parser failure rate <= 0.001
dense_transformer_v1 overall exact match >= 0.85 and replacement-affected exact match >= 0.80
all systems complete every KxD cell within resource limits with no leakage or context truncation
comparable_quality: delta_fast_memory_v1 overall exact match >= 0.95 in every KxD cell
its paired 95% lower bound versus the best learned non-candidate system is >= -0.01 in every KxD cell
replacement-affected exact match >= 0.95, unchanged-fact retention >= 0.99, unseen-composition exact match >= 0.90 and UNKNOWN exact match >= 0.95
mechanism_effect: on replacement-affected unseen-composition queries, candidate minus append-only ablation exact match >= 0.05 at each K
the paired 95% lower bound of that contrast is > 0 when pooled across D=2 and D=4
candidate retention is no more than 0.01 below the ablation and conformance tests prove a replacement mutates only bounded fast state
economic_effect: at K=512, D=4, A=100 and Q=16, the upper paired 95% bound on candidate full-cost time ratio is < 0.80 versus both dense transformer and retrieval baseline
candidate/dense and candidate/retrieval full-cost ratios do not increase from K=32 to 128 to 512 at D=4
candidate is Pareto non-dominated on exact match, full-cost time, update p95, persistent bytes and peak RAM/VRAM when the classical control is included
no economic claim is allowed if the classical control Pareto-dominates the candidate

decision_rules.positive: All control, comparable-quality, mechanism and economic gates pass. Record only a promising screen and request a separately frozen minimum three-seed replication on independent generator families; do not promote automatically.
decision_rules.mechanism_positive_economics_negative: Keep the narrow local-overwrite mechanism result, reject the lower-cost claim, and stop for a decision; do not hide classical dominance or tune on final.
decision_rules.negative: If controls are valid but comparable quality or mechanism effect fails, discard this exact delta-memory version after the one final screen. No rescue tuning, seed replacement or automatic new mechanism.
decision_rules.inconclusive: Any invalid control, leakage, context overflow, missing cost, timeout, OOM, crash, nonfinite output, incomplete cell or integrity failure preserves all artifacts and stops. No automatic retry.
decision_rules.transfer_and_novelty: This task cannot establish natural-language transfer, real-world knowledge updating, architectural novelty, a scaling law or an LLM successor under any outcome.

prior_art_boundary: LongMemEval motivates timestamped histories, knowledge-update, multi-session reasoning and abstention, but its released scale and LLM-judge/API evaluation are not used here.
bAbI motivates generated worlds, supporting-fact depth and configurable decoys; CLUTRR motivates held-out relation compositions.
End-To-End Memory Networks establish learned external memory and multi-hop reading; RAG establishes parametric plus indexed non-parametric memory.
Linear Transformers Are Secretly Fast Weight Programmers directly establishes the fast-weight interpretation and delta-rule correction, so no novelty is claimed for the mechanism itself.
stop_condition: This file is a proposal only. Stop at REVIEW-01-DECISION. A separate explicit user authorization must precede any generator/candidate implementation, training, freeze, EXP registration, scoring or final data generation.
